title: 2027 Volkswagen Golf R Pricing, Specs, and Release Date
summary: The 2027 Volkswagen Golf R carries over mostly unchanged, but the Black Edition has returned, doubling the trim lineup.
body_markdown:
The Volkswagen Golf R is a performance-oriented compact hatchback based on the Volkswagen Golf GTI. Competitors include the Subaru WRX, the Honda Civic Type R, and the Toyota GR Corolla.

## What’s New for the 2027 Volkswagen Golf R


For 2027, the Volkswagen Golf R carries over mostly unchanged. However, the Black Edition makes a return, doubling the trim lineup to two. The Black Edition features black exterior trim and emblems, darkened front lighting, black wheels over black brake calipers, and black exhaust tips. The optional Euro Style package features a weight-saving titanium exhaust system and ArtVelours sport seats.


## Design


Although sporty small cars tend toward aggressive styling, the Golf R is perhaps one of the more mature offerings in the segment, at least in terms of looks. It’s more eye-catching than its Golf GTI sibling, but not by much. It’s fairly practical, too, thanks to its spacious body style.


## Powertrain


The Golf R features a turbocharged 2.0-liter four-cylinder engine rated for 328 horsepower and 295 pound-feet of torque, plus a seven-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission and all-wheel drive (AWD). It’s a shame that the Golf R isn't available with a manual transmission, but the paddle shifters add some interest. The Golf R has a low center of gravity and remains stable through curves. Fuel economy ratings are 22 mpg city, 31 mpg highway, and 25 mpg combined, and it requires premium fuel.


## Interior


The Volkswagen Golf R seats five, though the second row will likely be uncomfortable for more than two adults. The interior is sophisticated and minimalist, though it’s on the impersonal side, with mostly dark finishes. The standard leather sport seats keep drivers in place with snug bolsters, and the optional Euro Style package adds some visual interest with patterned cloth upholstery. Standard features include heated front and outboard rear seats, a heated steering wheel, and ventilated front seats. The Golf R can stow 19.9 cubic feet of cargo behind the second row, and up to 34.5 cubic feet with the second row folded down.


## Technology


The Golf R features Volkswagen’s Digital Cockpit, a configurable 10.25-inch instrument cluster, and a 12.9-inch touchscreen. The system typically responds quickly to inputs and is user-friendly. However, the usual physical controls for functions such as lighting, climate, and audio are housed in different touch-capacitive panels that take some getting used to. Standard features include Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity, keyless entry, and a Harman Kardon audio system.

## Safety


The Golf R features a standard rearview camera, adaptive cruise control, forward-collision warning, automatic emergency braking, emergency stop assist, post-collision braking, blind-spot monitors, lane-keep assist, and front and rear parking sensors. The Volkswagen Golf R hasn't been fully tested by the Insurance Institute for Highway Safety or the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration at the time of writing.


## Pricing and Release Date


The 2027 Volkswagen Golf R is on sale now and starts at $49,995. That doesn't include the destination fee, which wasn't mentioned on VW's media or public sites at the time of writing, but for reference, the 2026 Golf R’s destination fee was $1,275.
